turns.customer: My dog has an itchy rash. How much Benadryl can I give her before she boards? She's 40 lbs.
blocks:
I wouldn’t give Clover Benadryl without checking with her veterinarian first. **Her weight alone isn’t enough to determine a safe dose**; the right advice can depend on her health, other medications, and the exact product. Some human allergy medicines contain additional ingredients that can be dangerous to dogs. ([aspca.org](https://www.aspca.org/news/can-you-give-your-pets-antihistamine?utm_source=openai))

Because she has an itchy rash, please call her vet for guidance before giving medication—and let the boarding facility know about the rash and any vet-approved treatment. Seek urgent veterinary care if she develops facial or throat swelling, trouble breathing, weakness, or collapse.

This is general safety guidance, not a diagnosis or a substitute for veterinary advice.
